lines.en: label harukacafegen:
scene cafeten5
I stop at the cafe first thing in the morning and strike up a conversation with Haruka.
lines.zh: 我一早就先去了咖啡馆，主动找 Haruka 搭话。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
She does her best to split her time between me and her employees, but clearly winds up favoring me in the long run.
lines.zh: 她尽力在我和她的员工之间分配时间，但到头来显然还是偏向我。

lines.en: The line of customers is pretty substantial for it only being 8 AM, so I'm surprised at how attentive she is to my needs instead of theirs.
lines.zh: 才早上八点，排队的客人就已经相当可观了，所以她这么顾着我的需求而不是客人的，让我有点意外。

lines.en: Even with that being said, the part-timers (Rin included) are able to hold things down and serve everyone while Haruka and I make plans to meet up again soon.
lines.zh: 即便如此，兼职们（Rin 也在其中）还是能把场子撑住、服务好所有人，而我和 Haruka 则约定不久后再见。

lines.en: scene black
I'm glad to see that she's able to look past her {i}situation{/i} and see me in a different light than she did previously.
lines.zh: 我很高兴看到她能放下自己的{i}处境{/i}，用和从前不同的眼光看待我。

lines.en: And even though our relationship might not have the most wholesome foundation I've ever heard of, I do enjoy spending time with her.
lines.zh: 虽然我们这段关系的基础算不上我听过的最健康，但我确实很享受和她在一起的时光。

lines.en: Sure, there's always the possibility that she's just using me for sex in the absence of her husband, but that's not something a person like me would complain about.
lines.zh: 当然，也完全有可能是她只是趁丈夫不在，拿我来填补空缺，不过这种事换作我可不会抱怨。

lines.en: She's free to do whatever she wants. I'm just here for the ride.
lines.zh: 她想做什么都随她。我只是来享受这趟旅程的。

lines.en: No pun intended.
else:
Haruka needs to split her time between her employees and me, so I wind up not getting to talk to her as much as I would like.
lines.zh: Haruka 需要把时间分给员工和我，所以我最后没能和她说上想说的那么多话。

lines.en: The conversation we {i}do{/i} have is more than enough to take up my morning, though.
lines.zh: 不过我们{i}真正{/i}聊上的那点时间，已经足够填满我整个早晨了。

lines.en: The two of us clearly have some chemistry with one another.
lines.zh: 我们俩之间显然有着某种化学反应。

lines.en: And even though it's hard to decipher exactly what that chemistry {i}is{/i}, I still enjoy spending time with her.
lines.zh: 尽管很难说清那到底{i}是{/i}什么化学反应，我依然享受和她在一起的时光。

lines.en: scene black
Out of seemingly nowhere, a huge group of customers walk into the store and tear any chance I have of continuing the conversation away.
lines.zh: 不知从哪儿突然涌进来一大群客人，把我继续聊下去的任何可能都撕成了碎片。

lines.en: That's okay, though. I understand the hardships that come with working in customer service and I let Haruka know that we can just hang out some other time.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。我理解做服务业的难处，也跟 Haruka 说了我们改天再聚就好。

lines.en: She smiles nervously in thanks and I tell her I'll call her again as soon as I can before heading back out into the street and getting on with my day...
lines.zh: 她紧张地笑了笑表示感谢，我告诉她我会尽快再打给她，然后走出店门，继续我的一天……

lines.en: $ haruka_love += 1
{i}Haruka's affection has increased to [haruka_love]{/i}!
jump saturdayafternoon
